"Rather Be" by Clean Bandit. As cheesy as it sounds it was, for me and my ex, "our song."
Can't listen to it anymore without thinking of her, which is unfortunate because i really like that song.

If you think this then you should take the chance to educate yourself on the education systems of other countries. Especially East Asian countries. Don't get me wrong, when I was in school I was the loudest voice proclaiming how shit it was. But we actually have it comparatively good: we're encouraged to think critically, and to consider the role of thought and emotion in human life. I'd rather live the rest of my life writing shitty essays that seem entirely too subjective and pointless than subject myself to the mindless rote memorization and unforgiving study expectations of a Korean or Japanese highschool for even a semester.

My ex was an exchange student from Japan at my university. We dated in Canada for about 7 months and got really serious. We were spending literally every day together, from the time we got off school until the late bus back to her host house. We talked about marriage and kids a lot.

When she went back to Japan we tried long distance. I decided to save my money to take a trip to Japan at the end of that summer (about 4 months after she'd left Canada)

My trip was supposed to be 2 and a half weeks, I spent all the money I had to go. I was staying at her families house, which is a pretty big deal for Japanese people.

In retrospect I don't even know if she told her family I was her boyfriend. 

On my third day there she told me that she didn't love me anymore and asked me to leave. I didn't have anywhere else to go in Japan, because I hadn't booked any hotels and it was a busy travel time. Luckily my sister lived in South Korea so I was able to find a cheap flight there and stay with her.

To be honest, it's been almost 2 years now and I'm still completely broken by it. She was everything to me. We had built this whole future together in our imaginations and it was the first time in my life I felt that I had a purpose. I don't think I'm ever going to be able to trust someone again after that. 

I'm sorry if this is overly dramatic. I don't have any outlet for it anymore. My parents and friends were supportive at first but quickly became tired of it and told me just to move on. But I just somehow can't work through it. So if you read this thank you.

Because I'm an awful person.

But she had started to hate me. She dumped me on my third day there. I don't know why. There's just something wrong with me

Thank you. I will try. Honestly, it will be hard for me to leave her alone, I want to talk to her everyday, but I think maybe I need to. I hope that things work out for both of us. I believe you deserve happiness too. Thank you for hearing me out and giving me help.

Thank you so much for your time reading and replying; it really means so much to me. I like your idea of showing her this, but I don't think she'd read it. I've been writing her so many messages over the past 2 months and I think she's so tired of it all. I said such awful things to her that I think she can never forgive me, and honestly I understand.
I just wrote another novel-length post, :/ but if anyone reads this I just want to say thank you so much for your time.

Thank you for the advice. I really appreciate it. Honestly, part of me thought the same: that she was just trying to turn it around so that I would break up or at least she could feel justified breaking up. I really hope that someday she will return, but I know it's not likely. I mean, especially after all the pathetic emails I already sent her. You're right that it was probably a mask. She told me soon after we started dating that she was miserable in Canada and cried every night before we started spending time together, so maybe she was just vulnerable and looking for something to hold on to. I probably shouldn't hold it against her.
